checks.scope: Relocations whose preserved outcome needs before/after evidence.
checks.observable: Compare paths/options/consumers/audiences, not only declaration names.
checks.consistency: The same-declaration exemption is weaker than DP-38 confirming-check requirement.
checks.exceptions: Intentional removals are valid; matching text alone is not preservation.
checks.fix: Record change evidence in planning/review; keep current runtime contracts at their owners.
checks.expression: Receiving-site and old-site narration blur live design with change evidence.

entries.rationale: A move can preserve a gate name while making the gate skippable.

checks.scope: Enumerated output values and terminal assignments over feasible paths.
checks.observable: A last-writer path trace can distinguish unreachable values from untested values.
checks.consistency: A promised value may need implementation rather than deletion.
checks.exceptions: Unevidenced but feasible values are correctly protected.
checks.fix: Repair required production paths; remove only unintended distinctions with consumers accounted for.
checks.expression: Last phase followed by later phase is an unclear description of terminal overwrite.

entries.rationale: The value-reachability detector is useful; its missing-path repair must preserve intended semantics.
